newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ERA uranium output jumps 168 percent.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ERA uranium output jumps 168 percent.

text.p: Energy Resources of Australia Ltd said on Wednesday its Ranger mine in the Northern Territory produced 1,100.3 tonnes of uranium oxide in the December quarter, a 168 percent increase on the 410.9 tonnes produced a year earlier.
Six month production rose 47 percent over the year earlier period to 2,143.6 tonnes from 1,458.7 tonnes, ERA said.

ERA said total sales for the December quarter rose to 1,472.2 tonnes from 1,450.7 tonnes a year earlier, consisting of 1,233.1 tonnes of Ranger sourced material and 239.0 tonnes of sales sourced from third parties.
ERA is 68.4 percent owned by Australian mining company North Ltd.
